supplier.description: The issuer's legal name as printed on the invoice.

supplier_tax_id.description: The issuer's tax identification number as printed, such as a Colombian NIT.

invoice_number.description: The invoice number as printed, without labels such as No.

issue_date.description: The date the invoice was issued, as YYYY-MM-DD.

due_date.description: The date payment is due, as YYYY-MM-DD.

currency.description: The invoice currency as an ISO 4217 code, such as COP or USD.

subtotal.description: The invoice amount before tax, as printed.

tax.description: All taxes combined, such as IVA and others, as printed.

total.description: The final invoice amount including tax, as printed.

line_items.description: One entry per printed invoice line, in the order printed.

line_total.description: The printed line total, as printed.

confidence.description: How confident the extraction is, from 0 to 1.
